$comment: Shared by ts/tests/adapters/gemini-sessionlog.test.ts and tests/adapters/test_gemini_session_logs.py. Synthetic transcripts written from the pinned upstream source (no installed-binary capture). Files under chats/ and projects.json carry two placeholders the tests substitute: __WORKDIR__ (the project root as gemini-cli keys it: path.resolve(process.cwd()), i.e. the physical absolute path) and __PROJECT_HASH__ (sha256 hex of that exact string).

sourceQualification.legacyLogsJson: tmp/<project-id>/logs.json holds user prompt history only (no usage)

main.$comment: g1 is re-appended once tokens arrive (counted once), g2 is re-appended with updated toolCalls (counted once), g3 is removed by $rewindTo, output 0 on g2 is preserved as a real zero.

unrelated.$comment: projectHash belongs to another project; must be rejected by discovery even when newest.

noUsage.$comment: gemini message recorded with tokens null: usage is unknown, not zero.

legacyLayout.$comment: The pre-TWA-96 helper looked for ~/.gemini/tmp/<basename(workdir)>/logs.json. That file is prompt history without usage and must not be reported as a session.
